description: Implementation of GTMLogger class and related logging utilities, including log formatting, filtering, and file handle extensions for logging purposes.

classes.name: GTMLogger
classes.description: Main logging class providing singleton access, configuration, and message logging methods.

classes.name: GTMLogBasicFormatter
classes.description: Formats log messages with basic formatting, including function name and message.

classes.name: GTMLogStandardFormatter
classes.description: Formats log messages with timestamp, process info, thread, and level details.

classes.name: GTMLogLevelFilter
classes.description: Filters log messages based on verbosity level and environment settings.

classes.name: GTMLogNoFilter
classes.description: Allows all log messages without filtering.

classes.name: GTMLogAllowedLevelFilter
classes.description: Filters log messages to allow only specified levels.

classes.name: GTMLogMininumLevelFilter
classes.description: Filters log messages to allow only levels above a minimum.

classes.name: GTMLogMaximumLevelFilter
classes.description: Filters log messages to allow only levels below a maximum.

methods.name: sharedLogger
methods.description: Returns the shared singleton logger instance.

methods.name: standardLogger
methods.description: Creates and returns a standard logger with default settings.

methods.name: standardLoggerWithStderr
methods.description: Creates a logger that logs to standard error.

methods.name: standardLoggerWithStdoutAndStderr
methods.description: Creates a composite logger that logs to both stdout and stderr.

methods.name: standardLoggerWithPath:
methods.description: Creates a logger that logs to a specified file path.

methods.name: loggerWithWriter:formatter:filter:
methods.description: Creates a logger with specified writer, formatter, and filter.

methods.name: logInternalFunc:format:valist:level:
methods.description: Internal method that performs the actual logging, formatting, and filtering.
